property_snapshot.Name: The Cerulean
property_snapshot.Notes: Baen Enterprises' premium Waterdeep bathhouse, Sea Ward. Nautilus spiral geometry with 80-ft sapphire crystal central dome (grown by Seliara Frostwind). Five access tiers: Entrance, Outer Ring, Central Dome, Inner Ring (6 temperature-variant baths), The Pearl (VIP monitored Veil space). Dual aqueducts (Northern glacial / Southern river). 170 total staff (124 bathing + 46 ops). Peri as operator. \~296,000 gp construction, 15,000-20,000 gp/month revenue. Pearl-Link relay to Neverwinter Athenaeum. Plate 05 of Empire Facilities Series. Held through Cerulean Holdings LLC (NCF subsidiary). Sources: [the-cerulean-architectural-document-corrected.md](http://the-cerulean-architectural-document-corrected.md), baen_bathhouses_and_water_[systems.md](http://systems.md)

records.title: Veil Docks Facility — Neverwinter Physical Operations Node

property_snapshot.Garrison: 34 total staff: 18 Veil operatives (1 Harbor Cell Lead \[Twilight\], 4 Dusk-tier, 12 Mist-tier, 1 rotating Conditioning Subject); 10 civilian NMWC (3 duty clerks, 2 gauge inspectors, 3 maintenance crew, 1 records clerk, 1 filtration technician); 6 Bloodaxe Legion contractors (two-person teams on rotating eight-hour shifts, report through Korgan not the Veil)
property_snapshot.Name: Veil Docks Facility — Neverwinter Physical Operations Node
property_snapshot.Notes: Neverwinter city-level physical operations spine of the Veil, disguised as NMWC Harbor Distribution Node Three. Surface: 120 ft dome, 750K gal visible cistern, public works office. Subterranean: 1.08M gal central reservoir, two 225K gal laterals, 12 ft service corridors. Under-bay: 10 ft trunk tunnel at 40-60 ft below mean low water, blackstone sheath, rail-cart system, covert corridor to Celestial Springs island (1.4 mi, \~7 min transit). Operations annex at 70-90 ft below sea level: cruciform chamber layout, 4,200 sq ft, training gallery + 4 holding cells + records chamber + command office + Memory Vault + surgical bay + brine cistern + eastern junction vault. Coastal escape tunnel to sea cave 0.6 mi north. Source File: [veil-docks-facility-neverwinter-v4.md](http://veil-docks-facility-neverwinter-v4.md). v4 supersedes v3 canvas.

property_snapshot.Garrison: No empire garrison. Veil operational cell (Vance + Ashwick), expeditionary footprint only.
property_snapshot.Name: Calimport
property_snapshot.Notes: City of Glory, capital of Calimshan. Perfume and spice trade hub; coastal metropolis south of Amn. Maker's Ward (tannery district) currently houses Seekers of the Unveiled Truth cult compound — former tannery repurposed 3 years ago by the Illuminated One. Active Veil operation: Yasmin al-Mahnoud extraction from Seekers of the Unveiled Truth, client Rashid al-Mahnoud (perfume merchant, 30-year trade). 3-day timeline to elevation ceremony. Operatives: Aurelian Vance (The Connoisseur), Brennan Ashwick (The Hound). Calimport is outside empire's direct control zone — expeditionary Veil operations only. Clean extraction opens Rashid-al-Mahnoud-mediated southern trade relationship.

property_snapshot.Garrison: Dr. Maltheus (continuous presence). Sania Valmorra (regular collaborator). Single Erata wafer at Anchor Forge during Maltheus sleep cycles. No standing garrison — Inevitable City perimeter defenses assumed upstream.
property_snapshot.Name: Maltheus's Laboratory — Three-Level Research Wing
property_snapshot.Notes: Three-level research wing inside the Inevitable City. Level One (Gallery of Correspondences) — comparative anatomy, complete devil nervous system, consciousness complexification sequence, cross-sectional brain tissue panels, crystallized blood lattice (Sania contribution). Level Two (Anchor Forge) — Maltheus's primary workbench, three converted demon anchor devices in different conversion phases, soul furnace testing rig with 23 preserved failure specimens, Erata Initiative wafer development station (one wafer per ten days). Level Three (Theoretical Chamber) — near-empty, four walls covered in continuous unsolved equation (Demiurge anchor conversion proof), two chairs, small table. Second chair is Sania's (wear pattern identifies it); their collaborative sessions in this chamber are the empire's most productive intellectual work. Access restricted to Arik/Shi'van/Sania/Maltheus at full-access; Inner Circle by escort. Leakage of output technology would alter continental strategic balance permanently.
property_snapshot.Source File: Conversation 72030607 (4 April 2026). Arik Forward Canon Locks Audit (24 April 2026).

property_snapshot.Name: Suzail
property_snapshot.Notes: Capital of Cormyr. Minimal Veil presence (3% monthly detection — lowest of all operational zones). Empire operating at the edge of Lirien's effective reach. Active holding: NCF Suzail Branch run by Dagny Ironfold — who is a Jarlaxle passive observer (Bregan D'aerthe network, HIGH detection difficulty). Dagny's most recent quarterly report surfaced sensitive NCF expansion plans to Jarlaxle, who entered the Cormyr market ahead of NCF. Dagny panicking. War Wizards of Cormyr investigating Green Vein Corridor overnight-construction report (Edmond Grayle incident). Strategic stakes: if NCF Suzail works, Cormyr expansion extends; if not, empire out of the kingdom for a generation. No dedicated Cormyr political advisor in the empire yet. Sembian merchant-princes watching slowly.

property_snapshot.Name: Luskan
property_snapshot.Notes: City of Sails. Sword Coast North working port. Moderate Veil presence (10%). Post-Kurth governance unstable. Second financial hub after Neverwinter. Baen holdings: NCF Luskan (Varrick Silverthorn), Thorn & Silver (Selah Thorn), Verification Services, Gold Lending, Lustrous Blade (Velanna Moonsedge), Safe Harbor Inn (Wren Sable), Fish Street Office, Veil Safe House. Strategy: legitimacy-conversion of criminal-economy operators into NCF clients. Amnian-backed competitor financial house entered last quarter. Harbormaster Sefa under pressure from unknown source, demanding bribe increase. Wren Sable + Velanna Moonsedge are internal vulnerabilities (drinking + skimming respectively). Parent of Fish Street Office and Veil Safe House existing Notion pages.

property_snapshot.Name: Celestial Springs
property_snapshot.Notes: Arik's private offshore island bathhouse near the Moonstone Mask, Neverwinter harbor. Three-tier bath structure (main thermal pool, steam sanctum, Mirror Depths Frigidarium). Glacial aqueduct from the Sword Mountains via Gauntlgrym-bored blackstone-sheathed tunnel. Covert under-bay corridor to Veil Docks Facility (1.4 mi, \~7 min rail-cart transit). Not registered as religious/civic. \~14 permanent staff. Arik's personal vault on-site holds Shadow-clearance file duplicates. Plate 04 of Empire Facilities Series. Source: baen_bathhouses_and_water_[systems.md](http://systems.md)

property_snapshot.Name: Dalelands
property_snapshot.Notes: Eastern river-basin region between Tethyamar and the Sea of Fallen Stars. Fourth-arc theatre on-horizon per userMemory. Geographic thesis: water flows downhill from the tunnel mouth (3,200 ft) to sea level through the Ashaba/Arkhen river systems over \~150–200 miles. Easier canal construction than the Hunding system but passes through territory the empire does not control and terminates at Sembian-dominated Sea of Fallen Stars ports. Active threads: Sembian mercenaries blocking Tethyamar-to-Dalelands transit; Zhentarim regional rebuild (Iselda Vorn, Soren Vask); Operation Evening Star (Lirien as Vesper Aldaine, long-horizon legend-building); Bloodaxe halfling scout-sniper section deployable. Sea-Fallen-Stars termini options: Selgaunt (preferred, politically hostile), Saerloon, Yhaunn. Candlekeep scholarly tradition overlaps and links to Simbul quest travel routing.

property_snapshot.Name: The Shadowed Passage
property_snapshot.Notes: Underdark corridor connecting the Menzoberranzan region to the surface near Luskan. Original escape route for Arik Baen and Lirien Nightwalker approximately 18 years before current campaign events (\~1476 DR). Surface terminus in the hills above Luskan (Sword Coast North). CANONICAL RETCON CLARIFICATION: Arik and Lirien fled voluntarily. They did NOT flee the destruction of House Baen'und. The destruction came later, approximately 5 years after their departure (\~1481 DR). At the time of the Shadowed Passage flight, Shi'van had not yet been conceived and none of her storyline existed. The passage is still canonically extant and could in principle be used again.
property_snapshot.Source File: Earliest U2 chats (\~March 2025). Chad canon ruling 24 April 2026 clarifying voluntary-flight framing.

property_snapshot.Name: Waterdeep Trading Office
property_snapshot.Notes: Three-story brick-and-limestone commercial trade office in Waterdeep's Dock Ward commercial quarter, six blocks inland from the harbor front. Northern Crown southern trade administration node. Not public-retail; by-appointment only, pull-bell admission. Single door plaque reads NORTHERN CROWN — WATERDEEP OFFICE / IMPORT-EXPORT ADMINISTRATION. Ground floor: reception hall with Corwen Dale (senior clerk/operational linchpin, conservative register, green-and-silver pocket-square marking Northern Crown affiliation to Waterdeep merchants who know the code), waiting room with six chairs and decanter of wine kept fresh daily, small private meeting room, back clerks' room with four standing-desk clerks handling manifests/customs/credit-letters. Second floor: three offices (senior trade administrator, senior clerk, two junior trade officers), conference room (18x14, walnut table for 10, dark-green leather chairs, Waterdeep Trade Compact in brass frame on inland wall, Sword Coast commercial routes map, sideboard). Third floor: records storage (Sylenna-specified fire-proofing), modest apartment used by senior Baen personnel during Waterdeep transits (Arik has slept here; Shi'van uses it when Celestial Compass Estate is socially compromised, good linen), Veil-dressed workspace maintained for occasional short-notice use by Veil personnel transiting the city (not primary Veil ops; Corwen knows, ground-floor clerks do not). Cultivated small-and-selective perception — turns away legitimate business regularly as market signal; Northern Crown trade relationship read as status marker. Corwen Dale recruited \~5 years ago via Varrick Silverthorn's background check.
property_snapshot.Source File: Forward Canon Locks Audit 24 April 2026 — Locations-DB gap pass. Business Registry `321e8214-84b0-8128-9cb9-fbb308ea2536` + Waterdeep commercial-quarter canon.

property_snapshot.Name: Verdant Cascades
property_snapshot.Notes: Public-private bathhouse on the Blacklake cliffs, Neverwinter. Three access tiers: Heron Pools (public), Moss Steps (mid-tier), Hollow Vault (noble/dignitary). 3,200 daily capacity, 2,150 average throughput, 2.6-hour water turnover, 68 daily staff. PPP structure with Baen Enterprises, NCF, Dockworker Union, Truesilver family, Neverwinter Municipality. The empire's civic-legitimacy flagship. Plate 03 of Empire Facilities Series (G. Hest / Thomas Crane). Source: baen_bathhouses_and_water_[systems.md](http://systems.md)

property_snapshot.Name: Baldur's Gate
property_snapshot.Notes: Sword Coast South anchor city. Light Veil presence (5% monthly detection). Baen holdings: Crownsite Canal Property BG, Split Fountain, Canal Housing Redevelopment, BG Aquaculture (3 pools), NCF BG Branch, Gold Lending BG. Tamsin Briarcleft is Office Manager at Crownsite + known External Reporting vector to House Oberon patriar family. Oberon has weaponized Tamsin's intelligence into a zoning challenge against canal district expansion. Corvin Seastrand (BG Aquaculture) skimming 2–3% of fish harvest, 18 months cumulative \~7,000 gp. Mirren Deepwell refused an Aldric approach (Edric Voss) but did not report. Council of Four governance; Flaming Fist neutral; Upper City patriar gap unaddressed.

property_snapshot.Garrison: No standing garrison. Jörmun's continued regional presence provides the cold signature that maintains containment. Periodic inspection by wyrd-bound assets (Traxex) and mage-cadre scouts.
property_snapshot.Name: Thirst Glacier
property_snapshot.Notes: Engineered glacier, Session 14 1498 DR. Buries the Thirst — pre-Netherese elemental entity. 55 miles east of Crown of Eight Springs. Contains but does not destroy. Centuries of expected containment duration if cold signature holds. Creates local cold microclimate distorting Anauroch ecology. Glacier is maintenance asset, not resource.

property_snapshot.Garrison: No empire garrison. Expeditionary Veil operations only (canonical: Peri + constructs/mimir support, 36-hour mission windows).
property_snapshot.Name: Athkatla
property_snapshot.Notes: Capital of Amn. Home of the Cowled Wizards (mandatory magical-activity hazard for any operation — spirit-lantern containment required for magical cargo). Site of canonical Athkatla Acquisition: 27th Eleint 1494 DR, Peri solo mission, Lantanese archive acquired from Harven Dalmost, FULL SUCCESS, 15,000 gp budget, 63 documents. Night Masks (Calimshan criminal org, significant Athkatla presence): 2 casualties owed from the Acquisition. Tenjin Kasuga introduced during extraction — recurring NPC, recruitment pending his arrival in Waterdeep. Districts: Waukeen's Promenade (central commerce, Dalmost's Antiquities), Market District (crowd-density evasion terrain), Harbor District (Night Mask territory, magical-contraband corridor). Expeditionary Veil theater only — no garrison, no permanent cell.

property_snapshot.Garrison: 3rd Cohort "Breaker's March" elements under Legate Runa Dornveil. Observation rotation round-the-clock on obelisk platforms. Camp perimeter garrison at the lower terminus of the underground passage.
property_snapshot.Name: Warden's Vigil
property_snapshot.Notes: Completed Late Mirtul 1498 DR, 4 days ahead of schedule, 2,600 gp under budget (final cost 27,400 gp). 60-foot granite-and-marble obelisk on 100-foot memorial plaza at northeastern approach to Crown of Eight Springs. Three observation platforms, 12 disguised arrow slits, 7,000-gallon cistern, 340-foot underground passage to forward camp, pre-positioned siege equipment foundations. Public identity: memorial to eastern deployment dead (167 names carved, 500+ reserved). Military reality: territorial marker + forward observation + defensive fallback.

property_snapshot.Name: Thorn & Silver Exchange — Luskan
property_snapshot.Notes: Two-story limestone banking floor on a Luskan commercial side-street. 140-year-old legacy institution (est. 1354 DR) operating continuously through catastrophe and reconstruction. Publicly independent; actually under NCF ownership since Selah Thorn brought it into the ledger during the Warehouse 12 arc. Ground-floor banking floor (40x28 ft, polished limestone, oak wainscoting, brass chandeliers, maple counter, grid of small brass-fronted safe boxes visible to patrons, working dwarven-locked vault hidden behind). Second floor administrative (Selah's office, meeting room, records, staff kitchen). Selah Thorn runs it in conservative-Luskan-banker register; knows regulars by name. Staff: 3 senior clerks (predating NCF acquisition, do not know institution changed hands, never will), 2 junior clerks (vetted for loyalty post-acquisition), Borrin (retired Luskan militiaman house guard, deterrent-level security only), Berya (dwarven vault clerk, NCF-loyal, handles dwarven tumbler locks and reserve movement between Thorn & Silver and NCF main branch). Operational role: small-merchant banking (NCF main branch deliberately doesn't serve this layer), legacy coin-exchange for dockside traffic, hidden capital routing between NCF operations. Vault deliberately light (\~15,000 gp) so a robbery would yield moderate score without triggering serious investigative response. Back window of Selah's office opens onto alley (watched). External security via Dorn Ironlock's NCF-adjacent operative at the café across the street every third day.
property_snapshot.Source File: Forward Canon Locks Audit 24 April 2026 — Locations-DB gap pass. Business Registry `321e8214-84b0-8104-815a-fe1101e6f8f1` + Warehouse 12 arc context.
